description: Turn off what you don't use. Nothing is deleted, and turning it back on brings it all back.

dishes.title: Dishes
dishes.description: Extra choices guests can make on a dish.

languages.title: Menu languages
languages.description: The language your menu is written in, and a second one guests can switch to.

sharing.title: QR code and analytics
sharing.description: Style your QR code and see how guests use your menu.

mainLanguage.label: Your menu is written in
mainLanguage.hint: Every dish and category name must be written in this language.
mainLanguage.missing: {{categories}} and {{dishes}} have no {{language}} name yet. Guests see their old name until you write one.
mainLanguage.confirmBody: What you wrote keeps its {{current}} text, which guests see until you write it in {{language}}. Nothing is deleted.

turnedOffNote: Qayema turned this off for your restaurant. Contact us if you need it back.

orders.label: Delivery and pickup
orders.description: Guests order from home, for delivery or to pick up.
orders.offNote: Guests can't order for delivery or pickup. Your past orders are kept.
orders.whatsappHint: Guests send you the order on WhatsApp. It won't appear on your Orders page.
orders.menuHint: Guests order inside your menu. Orders appear on your Orders page with a sound.

typeHints.delivery: Guests give their phone number and address.
typeHints.pickup: Guests give their phone number and come to collect it.

dine_in.label: Ordering at the table
dine_in.description: Guests scan the QR code on their table and order from there.
dine_in.offNote: Guests can still open your menu from their table, but can't order.
dine_in.dashboardHint: They appear on your Table orders page with a sound, and guests can follow their order.
dine_in.whatsappHint: They come to your WhatsApp with the table's name. Guests can't follow their order.
dine_in.needsNumber: WhatsApp needs your restaurant's phone number.
dine_in.noNumber: Your restaurant has no WhatsApp number yet, so table orders come to your dashboard.
dine_in.addNumber: Add it on the Restaurant page

askFor.label: Ask guests for
askFor.hint: Guests fill these in before WhatsApp opens. They appear at the top of the message.
askFor.addressHint: Guests then choose delivery or pickup. The address is only asked for delivery.

variants.label: Variants
variants.description: Let guests pick one option, like a size. Each option can change the price.
variants.offNote: Your dishes show without their options. Nothing is deleted.

addons.label: Add-ons
addons.description: Let guests add extras, like cheese, each with its own price.
addons.offNote: Your dishes show without their extras. Nothing is deleted.

qr.label: QR Studio
qr.description: Change your QR code's colours, add your logo and print table cards.
qr.offNote: Guests still scan your plain QR code. Your design is kept.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.description: See how many people open your menu and what they look at.

languages.label: Second language
languages.description: Let guests switch your menu to a second language.
languages.offNote: Your menu shows only its main language. Nothing is deleted.
languages.secondHint: If you change it, what you wrote in the old one is kept.
languages.saveFailed: Could not save your menu languages

pos.title: Connect to POS
pos.description: Your menu takes its categories and dishes from your POS: names, prices, photos, choices and what is sold out. How the menu looks stays here.
pos.howTo: In your POS, open Online menu, make a key for your branch, then paste the address and the key here.
pos.addressHint: The address your POS shows next to the key.
pos.keyHint: Shown once in your POS when you make it.
pos.keyRequired: Paste the key from your POS.
pos.linkedDetail: Your dishes are on their way. They show on the menu in a moment.
pos.linkFailed: Could not connect to your POS
pos.errorTitle: The last sync did not work
pos.unreachableTitle: Your POS has not answered since {{time}}
pos.syncFailed: Could not ask your POS for your dishes
pos.disconnectDescription: Your menu goes back to you: the dishes your POS made stay, and you can edit them here again. Changes in your POS stop reaching the menu.
pos.unlinkedDetail: You can edit your menu here again.
pos.sendOrders: Send orders placed in your menu to your POS
pos.sendOrdersHint: Each step taken in your POS reaches the guest's tracking page. Off, orders stay on your Orders page.
pos.sendOrdersWhatsApp: Your guests send their orders on WhatsApp, so none can go to your POS. Choose the menu as the way guests order to send them.
pos.ordersOn: Orders now go to your POS
pos.ordersOff: Orders now stay on your Orders page
pos.ordersFailed: Could not change where orders go
